scope: Targeted second-pass phrase-level electronic Arabic-to-Russian collation of printed volume II pages 601-602; not visually collated against 2019 print and not independently certified.
edition: 2019, edited by Nabil ibn Nassar as-Sindi, volume II

changes.justification: Quran 27:40 verifies the proper sequence, and the electronic extraction inverted the leading وَمَنْ and trailing position.

fixes: Removed unsupported 'excessively' from thanks to the king
Restored impossibility of reciprocal recompense even through gratitude, exact exchange/service reasoning, and three-fold negation of divine need
Restored author's clarification that self-beneficial gratitude is not blameworthy and maintained paragraph continuity on page 602
Restored that Allah loves, is pleased with, and praises the grateful servant, while all benefit accrues to the servant
Removed added explanation about alleged fallacy of king-comparison; kept only author's 'this reason suffices'
Restored analogy 'from one sacred precinct to another', omitted contrast with 'first distinction', and closing author statement

remaining: Visually verify printed 2019 pages 601–602 and exact Arabic quote typography
Independently review translation of the metaphors حرم إلى حرم and الفرق الأول in 602
Continue phrase-by-phrase page audits from 604 onward; previous first-pass screening does not imply certification
